name: Tatebayashi Kai
source:
A military man who commands a reserve unit of the Imperial Japanese Army and possesses supernatural abilities such as summoning the dead. 
He has sworn loyalty to the Emperor who rules over Japan and is well-liked, but for certain reasons he has now relinquished his rank. 
Due to his conscientious and uncompromising personality, he is regarded as a hindrance by the military authorities. 
He is of noble birth.

"It's fine if you don't understand. Once you do, you won't be able to get away unscathed. That's why, forget about it, will you?"
